blocks.x: How Achala Ledger is put together: the network fabric, the consensus gates and the inspection exports regulators ask for.
Structurally Achala Ledger is planes, not layers, workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.
What ships, in the order it ships, Achala Ledger architecture edition:

items: privacy model, audit exports, jurisdiction analysis

blocks.x: Runtime dependencies: Hyperledger Fabric/Besu, HSM fleets, W3C VC/DID, static/formal verification tools. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Achala Ledger follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
Bring one shared-record problem to a briefing. We will show the network, the consensus rules and the inspection views it would run with.
